title: browser-program.ts eval branch has no test
notes: The eval branch in src/main/browser/browser-program.ts (read the script file, refuse when it cannot be read) has no test; pnpm check lists the file as 'no test runs it', against workflow-rule-2. If the read or its refusal breaks, an agent's browser eval fails and no test catches it. Fix: move the decision into a pure function in browser-cli.ts with a test. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/371 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/370#discussion_r4688228513

comments.body: Duplicate of card 74aabb41, shipped for the same GitHub issue; cancelled.
